key_distinctions: Query membership is conditioned on retained target-game source-row existence and recorded role; it is not explicitly filtered to observed participation or known target outcomes.
Unknown-label query rows are retained, so it is incorrect to describe every query as known-participant-only.
Absent source player-games receive no C forecast in this cache; a full pregame roster execution/coverage claim cannot be certified from this pool.
The new A733offer panel retains missingCforecasts55 and allAunknown outcomes66. All667known labels haveCpoints; this does not prove pregame coverage or absence of source selection bias.
The667decided comparison is conditional on A qualified known played outcomes and available C points, with matched masks and reported outer733. It is not a full pregame population validation.
participation_label_equation: played=any(physical_stat>0 after NaN treated0 for this positive-witness test) OR any finite signed yardage!=0; known=played AND home_score/away_score present. Target(rec) returns an integer-supported explicit receptions value only when known. This affects training/scoring labels, not the season/week query mask.
population_equation: D=read_csv(facts.csv.gz) inner-merged with schedule on game_id, then restrict position in QB/RB/WR/TE. Pool=D[position in RB/WR/TE]. Query(origin)=Pool[season=origin.season AND week=origin.week]. No pregame roster/template membership or known-outcome filter is applied in that query expression.
remaining_owner_action: C owns any pregame-compatible extension: apply exact existing P1/P2 models/features to an independently qualified pregame player/team/role template under the same cutoff contract, retain missing/source cases and separately captured later outcomes. Such adapter parity/source eligibility needs owner validation; no fit or row fabrication is implied.
training_equation: train(origin)=Pool[season>=2022 AND kickoff+7days<first_scheduled_kickoff(origin) AND rec_label is not None]; fit imputation/scaling/player-team-defense categories from train; queries use same retained row's player/team/opponent identity and earlier-history features.
vintage: Current/revised postgame ordinary player-stat facts; seven-day availability is a declared reconstruction proxy. Query row historical team/position identity also comes from those facts. No retained pregame roster issue clock is bound in this path.
